_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score 26 sits mid-Panic, tape is a statistical coil with conflicting stress vs bottom signals and no named breaker, so HOLD is the graded base-rate call.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split — analyst explicitly HOLD/Panic; narrative supplies metals weakness context but no opposing phase or directional crypto call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound and fear/composite score holds inside 24-31 through next sessions
next_move.invalidated_if: Forced-selling flush drives score below 24 into Capitulation, or squeeze lifts it above 31 into Denial
